In Edinburgh, a little dog refused to leave his best friend.
In eighteen fifty-eight, his owner, John Gray, died.
Bobby followed him to the churchyard, and stayed.
Through rain and snow, he is said to have kept watch by the grave for fourteen years.
The people of Edinburgh looked after him. The Lord Provost even paid for his licence.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny never leaves.
